code_discovery.scan_notes: The ingredients for verified value attribution exist: company-scoped cost receipts, execution receipts with intent/idempotency hashes, verified workforce outcomes, CRM revenue journey state, Wisdom evidence-backed idempotent outcome records/revisions, Signal command/receipt/correlation lineage and Rewind governance receipts. No dedicated canonical value-attribution ledger or explicit anti-double-counting ownership model was found. Implement attribution as a new ledger/projection over immutable verified evidence, with a unique attribution identity and rules for baseline, incremental value, split/shared credit, supersession/reversal and no duplicate credit across agent/team/workflow paths.

code_discovery.scan_notes: A nearly complete provenance chain already exists. Workforce outcome feedback records company, task, actor role, correlation/causation, command receipt, idempotency, evidence refs and decision/execution refs. Wisdom outcome records add expected/actual result, resolution state, evidence refs, context_versions, revisions and idempotency. Signal pairs commands to receipts and preserves correlation/root causation; CRM carries the business revenue journey; Rewind retains governed recovery receipts. Build one value-attribution projection that resolves agent/team/workflow/version/effective-authority refs onto these immutable verified records rather than creating another outcome store.
